summary: Negrofoot tower from Hanover County, listed as relocated to Field Day of the Past in Goochland County; the association marks that entry gone and no source we read describes the site now.

facts.status_note: The association lists this Goochland entry as relocated from Negrofoot but also marks it Tower Gone.

events.note: Association lists the tower as relocated from Negrofoot (Hanover County) to Field Day of the Past (Goochland County); no date given

evidence.supports: Negrofoot tower listed in Hanover County

notes_for_editor: Conflict: the association's table gives the Goochland Field Day entry as Tower Gone, yet a Waymarking page (https://www.waymarking.com/waymarks/WM6Q0E) says the tower is on display there and visible from the road. Waymarking also gives the original site as Route 54 in Hanover County, with coordinates matching the Negrofoot record, and speculates the tower could be the former Short Pump tower. It is NOT cited: our fetch_text reader returns only the page title for it (the body appears to sit inside a form element), so its quotes cannot be machine-checked. Worth a human look, a photo or a call to Field Day of the Past. The FFLA VA list is the only source readable for the tower's status. No build date, design or staffing was found in any readable source.
